cause: Both default SDK pool adapters lacked checked-out connection error tracking, returned failed clients without discard, and allowed rollback failure to mask the original command or uncertain-commit error. Five focused pre-fix unit failures establish these SDK defects separately from the previously repaired BLU adapter.
changes: Consolidate direct SDK pool handling on createPostgresTransactionRunner, already shared by createErpFinancials.

Track asynchronous error events on standard PostgreSQL clients, reject around command/commit when a connection fails, preserve original errors across asynchronous or synchronous rollback failure, discard failed/begin-failed connections and remove only the temporary listener after release.
No automatic command retries. An uncertain commit must be resolved with original immutable payload/key.

Extend pool-client protocol with optional on/off hooks and release(error) hint; query/release-only clients and caller-owned runners remain supported. Caller-owned runners still own transaction safety; documented custom release/discard obligations.

coverage: original failure preserved through rollback failure
checked-out error rejected before commit even if work returns
connection error during commit treated as uncertain
failed begin invokes no work and discards client
direct pool facade uses shared boundary
actual backend termination after retirement event insert through direct SDK pool and exported runner; snapshot rollback, client discarded and retry succeeds

actual statement commit followed by lost acknowledgement and rollback transport error through both entries; original error retained, one commit, client discarded, exact retry unchanged state and one statement

validation.database: Disposable socket-only PostgreSQL15.19; isolation verified and removed
validation.types: scoped source/PostgreSQL/unit and BLU/Core/Future public consumer typechecks passed with4GiB heap
validation.intermediate: Initial PG test wrapper syntax error prevented execution; corrected. Typed wrappers replaced unsafe test reflection and callback-state checks were made lint-safe; final checks above executed on final implementation.
validation.limitations: No full-suite, production, provider, deployment or browser proof. No UI changed. Existing BLU custom transaction wrappers remain caller-owned and were separately tested in prior phases.

next: Integrate SDK183 statement retirement/public immutable receipts into BLU strict actor/scope adapter and durable browser recovery, keeping exact original payloads, independent context and retirement mode across reloads. Account identity remains immutable; current statement dates/versions must not block recovery of an accepted historical command. Then remaining AP approval/hold recovery, scale admission/measurement, production migration/custody/ownership and shared-consumer/Ship/live proof remain. SDK publication403 and production PostgreSQL provisioning dependencies remain unresolved; no rejected operation retried.
